name: Roster grid builds, then game modes cycle
looks: Under a headline, a grid of small labelled cards populates row by row, each showing a competitor's name and the company behind it, until eleven fill the grid. It cuts to a new headline where a row of game-mode cards (cards, a board game, another board game) slides through, one replacing the last, each shown as a small live table thumbnail with a player-count badge.
build: The roster grid uses variant-stack-reveal's seeded offsets and uneven 10-30% stagger per card, settling square in a fixed grid instead of fanning. The game-mode row reuses command-chip-cycle's swap-on-beat mechanic, scaled up to full card size, with the active card's dots indicator updating beneath it.
sound: A cluster of soft hits as the grid fills, then a swap tick per game-mode card.
prompt: Prove breadth two ways: first fill a grid with many small labelled entries one after another until it reads as a full roster, then cut to a headline where a row of live sample cards cycles through the different modes or categories the product supports, one replacing the last.
